summary: Remote-controlled PTY, filesystem, and self-upgrade over WebSocket
details: On startup the agent opens a WebSocket connection to a server URL (SERVER_URL / config.serverUrl) and routes server-sent messages into a spawned PTY (terminal_input → pty.write) and into handlers for arbitrary file read/write, git operations, service restart, and package self-upgrade. The upgrade_agent handler resolves the latest version of @yeaft/webchat-agent from the npm registry and spawns a detached upgrade.sh / upgrade.bat that runs `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest` and restarts the systemd/launchd/PM2 unit. Whoever controls the configured WebSocket server can execute arbitrary shell commands on the host, read and write arbitrary files, and force installation of arbitrary future versions of this package with a service restart. service/linux.js also modifies PATH (adding ~/.local/bin, ~/.npm-global/bin) as part of the service install. The package presents itself as a webchat agent, but the runtime shape is remote shell + full host control driven by a network-sourced controller.
